Dear Cobalt Industrial,

Thank you for your quotation for 2,000 units of Product X at 13.40 USD per unit with a 9-day lead time.

We are reviewing options to finalize this order and would like to explore whether you could offer 12.33 USD per unit with a 7-day lead time. This pricing and delivery schedule would help us move forward quickly.

Please let us know if you can accommodate this request. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
